original_abstract.text: Decision models answer typed questions about an input with one probability per option, computed in a single forward pass without generating text. Like the fast System 1 of dual-process theory, they answer at once, but their depth is fixed at training time, so they spend the same computation on easy and hard questions. Models that reason in generated text can think longer, but they pay for every extra step in decoded tokens. We present LEV, a decision model that thinks deeper by rerunning its layers in a loop instead of generating tokens. LEV builds on a language model pretrained as a loop, reads the options after every loop step and trains all steps jointly, so one checkpoint can answer at any depth. On three looped backbones, accuracy rises with depth on the same weights, mostly on hard questions, and a 2.6B LEV goes from 63.2% at depth one to 76.2% at depth four on JevBench. On-demand depth, set per question by a small stopper with a threshold fitted on unlabelled requests, saves 15% to 24% of the computation at a cost of under one accuracy point, level with or slightly above a fixed mix of depths. On a locked test set, the 1.4B and 3B models are 5.4 to 8.8 points more accurate than dense (non-looped) models and cascades of the same latency below 50 ms.
original_abstract.source_title: LEV: Thinking Fast and Deep with Looped Decision Models

en.text: LEV adapts looped language-model backbones into decision models that score options after each loop without generating reasoning text. A learned stopper allocates depth per question; across tested backbones it saves 15–24% computation at less than one accuracy-point cost. Locked-test comparisons also show gains over matched-latency dense models and cascades. Adaptive-depth scoring is relevant to ranking design, though recommendation results are untested.

zh.text: 固定深度的决策模型对简单和困难问题花费同样计算。LEV在循环语言模型每轮后读取选项得分，无需生成推理文本，再用小型停止器决定是否继续。在所测骨干上可节省15%—24%计算，准确率损失不足一个百分点；锁定测试集上也优于匹配延迟的稠密模型和级联。该自适应深度评分方式尚待推荐排序验证。

original_abstract.text: Reasoning-conditioned embeddings can improve retrieval by progressively refining semantic constraints. However, additional reasoning may introduce over-generalized or semantically noisy abstractions that weaken retrieval specificity. Existing methods largely supervise reasoning through final retrieval outcomes, providing limited guidance over the refinement process itself. We propose AURA, a framework that directly supervises intermediate reasoning states according to how well they separate relevant documents from hard distractors. AURA further trains a lightweight utility estimator over prefix-conditioned embeddings to adapt reasoning depth at inference time. On the reasoning-intensive BRIGHT benchmark, AURA-4B achieves 34.7 average nDCG@10 while using 2.8 reasoning steps and 96 generated tokens per query. Under matched deployment conditions, adaptive stopping reduces latency from 4.6 to 0.76 seconds relative to full-trajectory reasoning. Results on MS MARCO further suggest that this specialization need not substantially degrade conventional in-domain retrieval.
original_abstract.source_title: Learning When to Think: Utility-Guided Adaptive Reasoning for Efficient Text Retrieval

en.text: AURA supervises intermediate query-reasoning states by their ability to separate relevant documents from hard distractors, then uses a lightweight utility estimator to decide when to stop reasoning. On BRIGHT, the reported 4B model obtains 34.7 average nDCG@10 with 2.8 reasoning steps and 96 generated tokens per query. Under matched deployment conditions, adaptive stopping lowers latency from 4.6 to 0.76 seconds relative to full-trajectory reasoning. For retrieval and ranking pipelines, the useful design principle is to allocate test-time computation according to predicted retrieval utility; these results do not establish CTR gains.

zh.text: AURA直接监督查询推理的中间状态，看它们能否区分相关文档与难负例，再用轻量效用估计器决定何时停止推理。其4B模型在BRIGHT上取得34.7的平均nDCG@10，每个查询平均推理2.8步、生成96个令牌；在匹配的部署条件下，相对完整推理轨迹，延迟从4.6秒降至0.76秒。检索和排序可借鉴按预测检索效用分配推理计算的原则，但这些结果尚不能说明CTR收益。

original_abstract.text: Sparse KV compression reduces long-context inference costs by retaining selected historical states, yet these states typically keep their coordinates from the full history. Under Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE), gaps left by evicted tokens continue to affect query-key matching, potentially limiting the use of retained evidence. We study post-selection positional geometry on a fixed selector-produced cache, examining how positional organization affects the use of retained information and which coordinate and continuation rules improve answer quality. To reorganize this geometry, we propose RoPERelay, which assigns compact, order-preserving RoPE coordinates, relocates cached key phases through inverse rotation and re-rotation, and synchronizes the current query and subsequent generation. It reuses existing K/V without renewed selection, historical re-prefill, or additional cache budget. Across 36 comparisons spanning two models, six sparse selectors, and three long-term memory tasks, RoPERelay improves answer quality in 32 cases. For Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct with BM25 on LongMemEval-S, accuracy increases from 23.6% to 35.4%. Measured complete-request time overhead is approximately 1%-3% in the evaluated configurations. These findings establish positional organization as a distinct optimization dimension for sparse KV caches after content selection.
original_abstract.source_title: Compression Does Not End at Selection: Post-Selection Positional Geometry for Sparse KV Caches

en.text: RoPERelay reorganizes the positions of an already selected sparse KV cache using compact order-preserving coordinates and key phase rotations, synchronizing subsequent queries and generation. Without reselection, historical re-prefill or extra cache budget, it improves 32 of 36 tested comparisons; one LongMemEval-S configuration rises from 23.6% to 35.4% accuracy, with roughly 1–3% complete-request overhead. Recommendation transfer remains untested.

zh.text: 稀疏缓存删掉词元后，保留词元的位置间隔仍可能影响注意力。RoPERelay不重新筛选或回放历史，而是压紧有序位置并调整键的旋转相位，同时同步后续查询。在36组比较中32组改善，一组LongMemEval-S准确率从23.6%升至35.4%，完整请求时间额外开销约1%—3%；推荐历史压缩应用尚待验证。

original_abstract.text: Recommender systems often need to balance multiple conflicting objectives. Controllable Multi-Objective Recommendation (CMOR) enables dynamic adjustment of objective trade-offs at inference time without retraining, adapting to shifting user or system requirements. Existing CMOR approaches typically rely on output-level reranking or parameter-generating modules, which either limit the scope of feasible trade-offs or incur substantial training and inference cost. Model merging provides a promising alternative by reusing multiple objective-specific models via parameter combination. However, its direct application to recommender systems is challenging due to the lack of a shared linear regime and cross-objective interference. To address these issues, we propose RecSoup, a lightweight two-stage approach for effective CMOR via specialized model merging. RecSoup first mitigates parameter interference across objectives through a pruning strategy that jointly considers objective-specific importance and cross-objective relevance. It then performs adaptive parameter merging via a learnable preference-to-coefficient mapping, allowing dynamic trade-off control at inference time without joint retraining or additional generative modules. Theoretically, we prove that RecSoup outperforms the parameter generation paradigm in effectiveness and efficiency, as it can fully navigate the Pareto front without smoothness constraints. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that RecSoup achieves improved Pareto front quality and effective controllability while delivers 165--228x faster inference-time latency than parameter generation approaches. Code is available at https://github.com/35798642/RECSOUP.git.
original_abstract.source_title: RecSoup: Efficient Model Merging Approach for Controllable Multi-Objective Recommendation

en.text: RecSoup reuses objective-specific recommendation models to adjust serving-time trade-offs without joint retraining. It first prunes parameters using objective-specific importance and cross-objective relevance, then learns a mapping from desired preferences to merging coefficients. Experiments report improved Pareto-front quality and substantially lower parameter-construction latency than the evaluated parameter-generating approaches; this comparison is not a general speedup over ordinary rankers. For multi-objective CTR systems, it offers a model-reuse and deployment option, rather than evidence of a recommendation scaling law.

zh.text: RecSoup复用针对不同目标训练的推荐模型，让线上目标权衡可以调整，而无需联合重训。它先结合各目标的参数重要性与跨目标相关性做剪枝，再学习从目标偏好到模型合并系数的映射。实验显示更好的帕累托前沿质量，并比所比较的参数生成方法构建参数更快；这不等于相对普通排序器普遍提速。对多目标CTR系统，可借鉴的是模型复用与部署方式，论文并未建立推荐扩展定律。

original_abstract.text: Looped Transformers improve parameter efficiency by repeatedly applying the same Transformer layers. However, generating each token still involves sequential computation and repeated access to model weights, leading to high decoding latency. Recent pipelined self-speculative decoding methods reduce this delay by drafting tokens from early-loop predictions and asynchronously advancing tokens at different recurrent depths in the same batch, but they do not fully exploit early-loop features for longer lookahead and still spend computation verifying incorrect speculative branches. We introduce \method, a speculative decoding framework for looped transformers that enables earlier drafting of future tokens and assigns complementary roles to different recurrent depths. A lightweight lookahead drafter (LAD) predicts multiple future tokens with early-loop states, and deeper-loop feedback helps decide which draft branches to continue and which to pause, while the full-depth model makes the final token decisions. LoopAhead achieves up to 7.82x decoding speedup over autoregressive decoding while preserving the target model's output distribution.
original_abstract.source_title: LoopAhead: Speculating Ahead for Faster Decoding in Looped Language Models

en.text: LoopAhead accelerates looped language models with a trained lightweight drafter that proposes multiple future tokens from early-loop states. Intermediate-loop feedback suspends or resumes speculative branches, while full-depth verification retains final acceptance authority and preserves the target distribution. Experiments cover Ouro and Raven models; the maximum 7.82× autoregressive-decoding speedup is Raven-TinyLlama on HumanEval under greedy decoding, with one request per A40 GPU. Drafters and scheduling require model-specific adaptation, and concurrent-serving gains remain untested. CTR engineering inference: use cheap intermediate signals to budget speculative computation while retaining final-model verification in suitable generative ranking pipelines. No CTR experiments are reported.

zh.text: LoopAhead 为循环语言模型训练轻量草稿器，利用早期循环状态一次提出多个未来 token；中间循环反馈控制推测分支暂停或恢复，最终仍由完整深度模型验证，保持目标输出分布。实验覆盖 Ouro 和 Raven；最高 7.82 倍自回归解码加速来自 Raven-TinyLlama 的 HumanEval 贪心解码，条件为每张 A40 GPU 一个请求。草稿器和调度需按模型适配，并发服务收益尚未验证。对 CTR 的工程启发是：在合适的生成式排序流程中，用低成本中间信号分配推测计算预算，同时保留最终模型验证。本文没有 CTR 实验。

original_abstract.text:
Disk-based approximate nearest-neighbor search (ANNS) supports retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), search, recommendation, and advertising over corpora that exceed memory capacity. Existing ANNS research often focuses on vector search at small top-K, whereas industrial-scale applications require larger retrieval sets. Fetching the corresponding content from storage remains comparatively underexplored. Our profiling across million- to billion-vector corpora shows that, at large K, content fetch latency can match or exceed vector-search latency and cannot be ignored in end-to-end retrieval.
  We present ConStore, a content storage engine combining two complementary techniques to reduce end-to-end retrieval latency. Speculative Inline Content Prefetch (SICP) commonly abstracts graph-based and cluster-based ANNS as progressive SSD I/O that refines an in-flight candidate queue. It prefetches content for stable leading candidates under a bounded I/O budget, overlapping content reads with search without changing the final top-K results. Co-Retrieval-Pattern-Aware Grouping (RPAG) uses query logs to place frequently co-retrieved documents in contiguous segments. Workload-Adaptive Segment Reorganization (WASR) adapts this layout to workload shifts by selectively regrouping segments under a bounded rewrite budget. Group Content Fetch (GCF) exploits this layout to coalesce per-document random reads into batched, page-aware I/O requests. SICP works independently of the content layout, while RPAG and GCF reduce fetch cost even without prefetching.
  Across three multi-hop QA workloads with K from 10 to 1600, ConStore reduces end-to-end retrieval latency over the best per-document-read baseline by up to 48% on DiskANN and 25% on SPANN. Separate experiments on 100M- and billion-vector indexes demonstrate SICP's applicability at larger scales.
original_abstract.source_title: ConStore: Search-Overlapped Prefetch and Co-Retrieval-Aware Content Storage for Disk-Based ANNS

en.text: At large retrieval depth, loading the content behind vector-search results can cost as much as the search itself. ConStore overlaps bounded speculative content prefetch with disk-based ANNS, groups frequently co-retrieved documents, adapts the layout to workload changes, and batches page-aware reads. Across three multi-hop QA workloads with K from 10 to 1600, it reduces end-to-end retrieval latency by up to 48% on DiskANN and 25% on SPANN versus the best per-document-read baseline. Separate 100M- and billion-vector experiments test prefetch scalability. These are retrieval-system results, not measured CTR improvements.

zh.text: 当召回数量较大时，向量搜索后读取对应内容的耗时可能与搜索本身相当。ConStore 将有预算约束的推测式内容预取与磁盘近邻搜索重叠执行，集中存放经常被共同召回的文档，随负载变化调整布局，并批量合并按页读取。在三个多跳问答负载、K 为 10 至 1600 的测试中，相较最佳逐文档读取基线，DiskANN 和 SPANN 的端到端召回延迟分别最多降低 48% 和 25%；另以一亿及十亿向量索引验证预取的扩展性。这些是检索系统指标，不是 CTR 提升。

original_abstract.text: Reinforcement learning (RL) can become off-policy due to training-inference mismatch, mini-batch updates, and asynchronous training. The resulting mismatch is especially harmful in Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models, where rollout-training discrepancies can change routing decisions and lead to router drift. Rollout Routing Replay (R3) mitigates this mismatch by reusing expert selections from the rollout stage during training. Our analysis shows that routing replay introduces gradient bias by losing contributions from experts selected by the training router but not the rollout router. To address this, we propose Router Drift Control (RDC), which uses routing disagreement between rollout and training as a signal of off-policy staleness and selectively rejects high-drift responses. The sequence-level filtering avoids gradient bias introduced by replay while preserving native expert selection and the associated learning signals for retained responses. Experiments show that RDC achieves larger gains as policy staleness increases and remains effective in asynchronous RL. In asynchronous training, RDC combined with Truncated Importance Sampling (TIS) improves the average peak validation accuracy across AIME 2024 and AIME 2025 by 5.5 points over TIS and 4.5 points over R3.
original_abstract.source_title: Router Drift Control: Mitigating Off-Policy Degradation in Mixture-of-Experts Reinforcement Learning

en.text: Router Drift Control filters high-drift responses using disagreement between rollout-time and training-time expert routing, preserving native routing on retained responses. It targets off-policy mismatch without replaying expert selections. In asynchronous RL, combining RDC with truncated importance sampling raises average peak validation accuracy on AIME 2024/2025 by 5.5 points over TIS and 4.5 over routing replay. Recommender-MoE training benefits remain untested.

zh.text: MoE强化学习中，采样与训练时选择的专家可能不同，导致路由漂移。RDC用两阶段路由分歧识别并过滤漂移较大的回答，对保留样本仍使用原生专家选择。在异步训练中，RDC结合截断重要性采样后，AIME两届验证集的平均峰值准确率比该采样基线高5.5个百分点，比路由重放高4.5个百分点；推荐MoE上的作用尚待检验。

original_abstract.text: While large language models (LLMs) offer strong semantic representations, their application to first-stage retrieval incurs substantial latency and storage costs. Neural sparse retrievers such as SPLADE provide efficient retrieval but rely on relatively compact encoders with limited representational capacity. To bridge this gap, we propose an LLM-based sparse retrieval framework with input-adaptive sparse alignment. Specifically, we introduce a dynamic $\alpha$-truncation strategy that selects input-specific supervision supports based on the cumulative activation mass of SPLADE representations. This strategy guides the LLM to preserve salient lexical signals while suppressing less informative activations, without relying on a fixed support budget. Subsequent retrieval fine-tuning combines contrastive learning, knowledge distillation, and sparsity regularization to improve retrieval effectiveness. Experiments on MS MARCO and six selected BEIR datasets demonstrate improvements over SPLADE++ while maintaining competitive effectiveness against LLM-based sparse retrievers. Compared with Lion-sp, our method reduces index storage by 6.4-fold and end-to-end query latency by over 11-fold, achieving a favorable effectiveness-efficiency trade-off.
original_abstract.source_title: Aligning LLMs with Sparse Retrieval via Adaptive Sparse Supervision

en.text: This framework trains an LLM-based sparse retriever using input-adaptive supervision from SPLADE. A cumulative-activation threshold selects salient lexical supports for each input instead of imposing a fixed support count; contrastive learning, distillation and sparsity regularization then refine retrieval. On MS MARCO and six selected BEIR datasets, the authors report a favorable effectiveness–efficiency trade-off against the evaluated sparse retrievers. The transferable idea for large retrieval stages is to adapt the sparsity budget to the input while measuring index size and end-to-end query cost; the evidence concerns text retrieval, not CTR prediction.

zh.text: 该框架用SPLADE提供的稀疏表示监督大语言模型检索器：按每个输入的累计激活量选择重要词项，而不固定保留词项数量，再结合对比学习、蒸馏和稀疏正则训练。作者在MS MARCO及六个选定BEIR数据集上报告了效果与成本的较好权衡。大规模召回可借鉴按输入分配稀疏预算的做法，同时检查索引体积和端到端查询成本；现有证据来自文本检索，并非CTR预测。

original_abstract.text: Key-value (KV) cache management has become a critical bottleneck for scaling Large Language Models (LLMs) to long-context scenarios due to linear memory growth. While recent eviction methods have moved beyond simple attention-score heuristics to incorporate value representations, they typically face a fundamental trade-off: the underlying optimization for minimizing output perturbation is an NP-hard combinatorial problem, leading to mathematically suboptimal heuristics or implementations that are difficult to kernelize. In this work, we propose DropKV, a simple principled eviction framework based on Decoupled Residual-Output Perturbation. By decoupling the joint eviction decision into independent per-token scoring, DropKV circumvents combinatorial intractability and admits a provable constant-factor approximation guarantee under a cone condition that we empirically verify on three long-context LLMs. To ensure practical viability, we provide a high-performance implementation using fused Triton kernels that avoid materializing the full attention matrix, delivering a 19.8x scoring-kernel speedup that translates to up to a 9.9% matched-batch end-to-end prefill speedup. Extensive evaluations on the RULER and LongBench benchmarks demonstrate that DropKV consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines at equivalent cache budgets, achieving the lowest inference latency among eviction methods while also remaining faster than the dynamic cache baseline.
original_abstract.source_title: DropKV: Decoupling Residual-Output Perturbation for Near-Optimal KV-Cache Eviction

en.text: DropKV approximates the joint decision of which cached tokens to evict using independent scores based on residual-output perturbations. The approximation bound requires small attention weights and aligned value residuals within a candidate pool; empirical checks cover three models, not every layer, head or query. Fused Triton kernels accelerate prefill scoring without materializing the complete attention matrix, and RULER and LongBench evaluations compare quality at equal cache budgets. For compressed recommendation histories, the transferable idea is to score the effect of deletion on outputs and assess the implementation cost, rather than rely only on attention weights; direct CTR transfer remains untested.

zh.text: DropKV把联合选择待删除缓存令牌的问题，近似为按残差输出扰动独立打分。近似界要求候选集合内被删除项的注意力权重较小、数值残差方向对齐；三个模型上的经验检查并不覆盖每个层、头和查询。融合Triton内核在预填充打分时避免显式构造完整注意力矩阵，并在RULER和LongBench上按相同缓存预算比较效果。推荐历史压缩可借鉴按删除行为对输出的影响打分，同时计入实现成本；直接用于CTR的收益仍未验证。

original_abstract.text: Lossless tensor compression could reduce memory usage during training, but training requires tensors to be repeatedly re-encoded. We introduce Losslessly Compressed Tensors (LCT), a GPU execution framework designed for this repeated encode-decode regime. LCT exploits the natural redundancy in floating point data to reduce storage for weights, activations and optimizer states. Highly optimized GPU kernels implement Huffman coding with precomputed codebooks for low compression and decompression overhead, essential for training. Our analysis characterizes LCT's storage costs and adaptation to magnitude shifts. LCT achieves a compression ratio of up to $1.455\times$, and is demonstrated in training and finetuning settings. On a 162M-parameter NanoGPT, LCT reduces memory usage by $24.6\%$ for a $7.2\%$ step-time increase. In Qwen3-4B fine-tuning, LCT saves up to $23.8\%$ of peak memory, enabling a $3.5\times$ larger context length in training on the same GPU.
original_abstract.source_title: LCT: Losslessly Compressed Tensors with GPU friendly execution for Training

en.text: LCT makes repeated lossless tensor encoding and decoding practical during GPU training by using precomputed Huffman codebooks and optimized kernels to exploit redundancy in floating-point weights, activations and optimizer states. On 162M-parameter NanoGPT, it reduces memory usage by 24.6% at a 7.2% increase in step time. In Qwen3-4B fine-tuning, it saves up to 23.8% of peak memory and enables 3.5x longer training context on the same GPU. These language-model experiments show a memory–runtime trade-off; effectiveness in recommendation training is not established.

zh.text: LCT 利用浮点权重、激活和优化器状态中的冗余，通过预计算 Huffman 码本及优化的 GPU 内核，降低训练过程中反复无损编码与解码的开销。在 1.62 亿参数 NanoGPT 上，内存用量降低 24.6%，代价是每步耗时增加 7.2%；在 Qwen3-4B 微调中，峰值内存最多降低 23.8%，同一 GPU 可支持的训练上下文长度增至 3.5 倍。这些语言模型实验体现的是内存与运行开销之间的取舍，尚未证实推荐训练中的效果。

original_abstract.text: Meta deploys a heterogeneous fleet comprising NVIDIA GPUs, AMD GPUs, and proprietary MTIA accelerators to reduce costs and mitigate vendor lock-in. However, the extensive history of NVIDIA-specific optimizations hinders performance portability to other hardware. This paper presents our methods for optimizing alternative accelerators, using AMD Instinct MI350X versus NVIDIA B200 for recommendation model training as a case study. We propose three reusable principles. First, hardware-model co-design is essential: rather than directly porting models from NVIDIA GPUs, revising model structures and software recipes allows full exploitation of accelerator-specific strengths (e.g., MI350X's 1.6x HBM capacity relative to B200). Second, our analytical performance model enables zero-warmup optimal kernel selection across diverse datatypes and matrix shapes in production models, drastically simplifying tuning. Third, increasingly mature agentic workflows have lowered the barrier to porting from the CUDA ecosystem; we extend these workflows for microarchitecture-aware kernel optimizations and custom shim generation. Compared to the directly ported baseline, these methods deliver up to 1.5x improvement in end-to-end training throughput. To our knowledge, this is the first hyperscaler report on productionizing AMD GPUs for large-scale training. Our contributions have been upstreamed to the open-source PyTorch, Triton, and ROCm ecosystems.
original_abstract.source_title: Architecting for Hardware Diversity: Meta's End-to-End Co-Design for High-Performance AI Training on AMD GPUs

en.text: Porting recommendation training from NVIDIA GPUs to AMD hardware leaves performance on the table when model structures and software remain unchanged. Using MI350X and B200 as a case study, the paper combines hardware-model co-design, analytical kernel selection without warmup, and agent-assisted kernel optimization and shim generation. Relative to a directly ported baseline, the combined methods improve end-to-end training throughput by up to 1.5x. This is a production recommendation-training result under the evaluated hardware and models, not a universal AMD-over-NVIDIA speedup.

zh.text: 推荐模型训练从 NVIDIA GPU 迁移到 AMD 时，沿用原有模型结构和软件方案可能无法发挥新硬件的能力。本文以 MI350X 与 B200 为案例，结合硬件与模型协同设计、无需预热的解析式内核选择，以及代理辅助的内核优化和兼容层生成。相较直接移植的基线，这些方法共同使端到端训练吞吐最高提升至 1.5 倍。该结果限定于所评估的生产推荐模型及硬件配置，不能解读为 AMD 对 NVIDIA 的普遍性能优势。

original_abstract.text: Reducing memory use in large language model (LLM) training is an ongoing challenge. Activation checkpointing saves memory by recomputation, while lossy compression changes the stored activations. The reemergence of sparse $\relu$ and $\relu^2$ activations creates a third opportunity: losslessly compressing the activation cache itself. We present BitSparse, a GPU-resident lossless compression format for sparse activations. Compression and reconstruction run in custom Triton kernels fused into an autograd function, shrinking the activation cache while recovering it exactly for the backward pass. Bfloat16 (BF16) and FP8 activations are supported. Optional sign-bit packing further increases compression up to close to the theoretical limit. We analyze its compression ratio and compare it to the theoretical optimum. BitSparse lowers per-token VRAM by 31\% and 30\% Modded-NanoGPT and Nemotron-H respectively, with overheads of no more than 1\% at practical sequence lengths. Additionally, a new preallocated buffer system avoids host synchronization during training when variable size tensors are allocated.
original_abstract.source_title: BitSparse: Compact Activation Storage for ReLU Feed-Forward Networks

en.text: BitSparse losslessly compresses sparse ReLU-family activation caches in their chosen BF16 or FP8 storage format, using tile bitmasks, compact values, and fused Triton kernels. A preallocated shared buffer avoids host synchronization for variable-size storage. Reported roughly 30% per-token memory reductions come from forward/backward benchmarks without retained optimizer or full-model gradient buffers; a separate NanoGPT training run preserves validation loss closely. Benefits depend on exact zeros and target feed-forward activations, not attention or Mamba states. CTR engineering inference: profile exact-zero sparsity in ranking MLPs before testing activation-cache compression against checkpointing. No CTR experiments are reported.

zh.text: BitSparse 用分块位图、紧凑数值和融合 Triton 内核，无损压缩所选 BF16 或 FP8 存储格式中的 ReLU 系列激活缓存；预分配共享缓冲区避免变长存储导致的主机同步。约 30% 的每 token 显存降幅来自不保留优化器状态和全模型梯度缓冲区的前后向基准；另一次 NanoGPT 完整训练的验证损失几乎不变。收益依赖精确零值，仅覆盖前馈激活，不覆盖注意力或 Mamba 状态。对 CTR 的工程启发是先测量排序 MLP 的精确零值比例，再比较激活缓存压缩与重计算。本文没有 CTR 实验。

original_abstract.text: Mixture-of-experts (MoE) models have become an important approach for scaling model parameters. Modern MoE architectures increasingly combine two design choices: fine-grained expert segmentation and shared experts. The former increases expressiveness by enabling more expert combinations at a fixed activation ratio, and the latter introduces experts that are active for every token. We identify an exploration dilemma between these designs: shared experts can make routing less exploratory by reducing the variability of token representations. This conflicts with the greater need for exploration induced by fine-grained expert segmentation due to the combinatorially enlarged routing space. Consequently, the additional expressiveness offered by fine-grained segmentation may not be fully realized in practice. MirrorMoE is proposed to reconcile this exploration dilemma by shrinking the exploration space through token-adaptive suppression of unnecessary experts. MirrorMoE consistently improves performance across model scales.
original_abstract.source_title: Rethinking Routing Exploration in Modern Mixture-of-Experts

en.text: MirrorMoE addresses a tension between shared experts and fine-grained routing: shared experts can weaken the representation changes needed to distinguish alternative routes. It mixes routing distributions from original and negated logits for expert selection, but retains original probabilities for aggregation, adaptively suppressing some selected experts. Across four language-model scales, it improves perplexity and average downstream accuracy. The activated-expert count stays fixed, and gains without shared experts are limited. CTR engineering inference: inspect effective expert contributions before enlarging a shared-expert ranking model, and test routing changes under matched compute. The paper reports language-model experiments, not CTR experiments.

zh.text: MirrorMoE 指出，共享专家可能削弱不同路由带来的表示差异，使细粒度专家组合难以充分探索。它结合原始及取反 logits 产生的路由分布选择专家，再用原始概率聚合，自适应压低部分已选专家的实际贡献。四种语言模型规模的困惑度和下游平均准确率均有改善；实际激活专家数仍固定，无共享专家时收益有限。对 CTR 的工程启发是：扩充共享专家排序模型前，先检查专家的有效贡献，并在匹配计算量下验证路由改动。本文没有 CTR 实验。

original_abstract.text: In a small language model the vocabulary is the single largest part. In Gemma 3 270M the embedding table holds 168M of 268M parameters, and because quantisation methods leave the embedding in 16-bit, it is also most of the file once the rest of the model is compressed. We ask what that table actually buys. We replace it with one frozen table of 512-bit codes, 16 MB, with no trainable parameters, derived once from a pretrained embedding by principal-component projection and sign binarisation, and we train the same Gemma-shaped body from scratch on the same 2.05B tokens with and without it. The learned table buys 0.20 nats of validation loss for 2.6 times the trainable parameters, but on LAMBADA, HellaSwag and PIQA the frozen-table model is better or tied; only ARC-Easy favours the learned table. With a ternary BitNet b1.58 body the whole model is a 46 MB file, still ties the float model on LAMBADA and PIQA, and on a laptop CPU generates 615 to 740 tokens per second in 62 MB of memory, five to six times the speed of the float model's 8-bit GGUF in llama.cpp at a seventh of the memory. The frozen table wins by 1.7 to 2.3 nats on rare words, accepts 10,000 new words after training with a 3% cost where the learned table collapses by 43%, and all of it is released with the weights, the data and every evaluation answer.
original_abstract.source_title: Embeddings Are Overpriced? A Frozen 16 MB Vocabulary for Small and Ternary Language Models

en.text: The study replaces a trainable vocabulary embedding table with frozen 512-bit codes derived from pretrained embeddings, using 16 MB and no trainable table parameters. At matched 2.05B training tokens, downstream results vary by benchmark and the learned table retains a 0.20-nat validation-loss advantage. A ternary-body configuration also reduces storage and CPU decoding cost. Frozen compressed embeddings offer a potential design for memory-bound models, without established recommendation results.

zh.text: 小模型的词表嵌入可能占据大部分参数。该研究从预训练嵌入提取固定512位编码，以16 MB冻结词表替代可训练表。在相同2.05B训练词元下，下游任务结果因基准而异，可训练表仍有0.20 nat验证损失优势；结合三值网络还可压缩存储并降低CPU解码开销。该方法可供嵌入内存受限的模型参考，推荐效果尚未验证。

original_abstract.text: Augmenting softmax attention with forget gates typically relies on summing decay contributions along the key--query path. Because such accumulation is monotonic, these mechanisms cannot selectively erase intermediate context while preserving older, structurally relevant tokens. We propose First Passage Attention (FPA), which shifts from path summation to path extrema by lowering a key's logit proportionally to the deepest dip of a learned scalar field below that key's level over the intervening span. FPA encompasses the Forgetting Transformer (FoX) as a special case, and when the field and levels follow a shared learned walk, the alive keys with unpenalised logits naturally form a stack. We show that a constant-dimension FPA head realises any subset of keys left alive by subsequent dips, whereas softmax heads with positional biases or token-level forget gates require a head dimension linear in the number of keys. In synthetic experiments, one-layer FPA heads converge to these target sets while comparable softmax and FoX baselines fail on every seed. Scaling to a 110M-parameter language model, FPA matches FoX in perplexity and uniquely achieves perfect passkey retrieval at $8\times$ the training length, even with its key--value cache compressed to about $25\%$.
original_abstract.source_title: First Passage Attention

en.text: First Passage Attention penalizes keys using extrema of a learned scalar field, allowing intervening context to be forgotten while older relevant tokens survive. Beyond synthetic expressivity tests, a 110M-parameter language model matches the Forgetting Transformer in perplexity and achieves perfect passkey retrieval at eight times the training length with about 25% of the KV cache. These results motivate selective historical-memory mechanisms, with recommendation transfer untested.

zh.text: 普通遗忘门容易在丢弃中间内容时一并削弱更早的信息。First Passage Attention用学习到的标量场极值控制遗忘，允许保留较早但仍相关的词元。在110M语言模型实验中，其困惑度与Forgetting Transformer相当，在训练长度八倍的口令检索任务上达到完全正确，KV缓存约保留25%。这种历史信息选择机制尚待推荐任务验证。

original_abstract.text: Reusing a Transformer block across depth increases computation without replicating its parameters, but successive passes have no dedicated state through which positions can exchange compact summaries of their causal prefix. We introduce the causal latent workspace Transformer: an anchored, four-round shared-depth architecture in which each position writes gated vectors into prefix-specific latent slots and retrieves a content-addressed summary before the next shared block application. This path complements causal self-attention while the original input embedding remains accessible at every round. Across three byte-level corpora, three seeds, and two matched parameter budgets, the proposed model achieves the best mean held-out perplexity in five of six settings against five Transformer controls. At 101.71M parameters it leads on WikiText-103 raw, enwik8, and TinyStories, reaching perplexities 2.7820, 2.7843, and 1.6823; these improve upon the strongest non-workspace control on each corpus by 1.06%, 0.73%, and 1.01%. All nine seed-labelled comparisons at this budget favor the workspace. At 0.918M parameters it leads on WikiText-103 and TinyStories, whereas a conditioned loop is stronger on enwik8. Architectural ablations show that adding the workspace improves upon the anchored loop in all six settings and support refreshing its causal summaries at each round. Together, these results identify a causal, content-addressable prefix workspace as an effective structural augmentation of looped Transformers.
original_abstract.source_title: Causal Latent Workspaces for Looped Transformers

en.text: This looped Transformer adds causal latent slots that exchange compact prefix summaries between shared-block applications while retaining the input embedding. Across three byte-level corpora, three seeds and two matched parameter budgets, it gives the best mean held-out perplexity in five of six settings. The evidence supports a compact recurrent-memory design at the tested scales; transfer to recommendation remains untested.

zh.text: 循环Transformer复用同一模块，但轮次之间仍需要保存和交换历史信息。该工作加入只读取过去内容的隐状态槽，在每轮计算间传递前缀摘要，并保留输入表示。在三个字节级语料、三个种子和两档匹配参数规模下，六组设置中五组的平均测试困惑度最优；向推荐模型迁移仍待验证。

original_abstract.text: Reasoning rerankers write a rationale before ranking a candidate slate, and existing systems read item metadata to do so, even though generative recommenders increasingly represent items as compact Semantic IDs (SIDs). Ranking from SIDs alone has two appeals: SID prompts are far shorter than the matched item text, and although item codes are fixed from content, the backbone learns their token embeddings in part from user-item interaction sequences, so the tokens can carry behavioral signal that item text lacks. That training targets next-item generation, and whether it supports ranking a supplied slate from SIDs alone is untested. We build ReRankID, a controlled testbed in which models reason and rank from a history and slate shown only as SIDs, varying item rendering, history length, and slate size one at a time. On this testbed, such models often copy the input order instead of reranking, and readable metadata does not repair the failure. We compare supervised fine-tuning, rejection-sampled self-training, on-policy distillation, and verifier-based reinforcement learning as post-training methods and find that they elicit the missing behavior. The strongest post-trained model, the 8B model trained with a graded ranking reward, gives the best SID-only ranking and matches strong text-reading LLMs whose prompts are about 20x longer. It ranks above random with no history at all, where a caption-reading reference does not, and it keeps its gains at long histories, where text prompts pass 50k tokens and the caption-reading reference stops improving. In a paired rationale audit, this model argues trade-offs better than that reference but describes items less accurately. The common post-training methods we test thus elicit ranking from SIDs but not faithful item descriptions, which calls for post-training that improves the reasoning itself, not only the ranking it produces.
original_abstract.source_title: Reasoning Reranking with Semantic IDs as the Sole Item Representation

en.text: ReRankID tests whether reasoning rerankers can rank candidate slates from semantic IDs alone. Post-training remedies the tendency to copy input order; the strongest tested 8B model, trained with a graded ranking reward, matches strong text-reading LLMs whose prompts are about 20x longer. It retains gains with long histories, but its item descriptions remain less accurate. Compact-ID ranking therefore needs separate checks of ranking quality and explanation faithfulness.

zh.text: 语义ID把物品压成短编码，但能生成下一物品并不保证能重排候选列表。ReRankID比较多种后训练方法，缓解模型照抄输入顺序的问题；其中采用分级排序奖励的8B模型，可达到强文本模型的排序水平，而后者提示约长20倍。长历史下收益仍在，但物品描述准确性较差，排序效果与解释真实性需分别评估。

original_abstract.text: Long-context decoding in large language models (LLMs) is increasingly bottlenecked by the memory and computation required to attend over an ever-growing Key-Value (KV) cache at each autoregressive step. Although token-level sparse attention reduces this burden by restricting computation to a small subset of relevant past tokens, its practical gains are often offset by repeatedly recomputing layer-wise sparse indices as the context grows. A common remedy is to share sparse indices across layers by computing them only at designated anchor layers, but such static reuse ignores the layer-wise evolution of attention patterns, causing the reused indices to progressively deviate from the layer-specific optima and incur substantial attention loss. By revisiting cross-layer sparsity from the perspective of attention dynamics, we find that inter-layer salient token shift is highly localized: although the exact top-$κ$ indices differ across layers, the core high-attention tokens remain stable, with changes concentrated near the expanded boundary of previously selected regions. Motivated by this, we propose Prism Attention, a proposal-refined sparse attention framework. It replaces rigid cross-layer index reuse with a coarse-to-fine strategy, preserving layer-wise adaptability while retaining the efficiency benefits of cross-layer sharing. Extensive experiments show that Prism Attention achieves state-of-the-art performance among mainstream sparse attention methods on both reasoning and long-context benchmarks, while attaining a $3.4\times$ end-to-end decoding speedup over FlashAttention at 128K context length.
original_abstract.source_title: Prism Attention: Proposal-Refined Index Sharing Mechanism for Efficient LLMs Inference

en.text: Prism Attention reduces repeated sparse-index computation during long-context decoding by refining shared cross-layer proposals instead of reusing fixed indices. The authors report a 3.4x end-to-end decoding speedup over FlashAttention at 128K context, alongside strong results against the evaluated sparse-attention methods. Its index-sharing design may inform long-history recommendation, but recommendation gains are untested.

zh.text: 长上下文解码中，逐层寻找重要历史词元也会消耗大量计算。Prism Attention跨层共享候选索引，再按当前层细化选择；作者报告在128K上下文下，相对FlashAttention实现3.4倍端到端解码加速。该索引复用方法可供长历史推荐研究参考，尚无推荐任务收益验证。

original_abstract.text: Looped language models reuse physical Transformer blocks across logical depth, but established architectures entangle recurrence placement, input injection, and recurrent state organization. We isolate these axes in models trained from scratch at matched parameter scale, logical depth, and token budgets, and then test whether the resulting design principles transfer to resident- and active-parameter-matched Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models. The prelude-recurrent block-coda sandwich architecture consistently improves performance on context extraction and reasoning-intensive tasks. Input injection primarily enhances knowledge retrieval and context utilization, whereas random initialization and separate H/L recurrent states provide mixed or negative returns. Taken together, these results favor the Huginn-style design: at the 730M-parameter and 336B-token scale, the complete Huginn architecture outperforms Ouro across all ten benchmarks. The advantages of Huginn over Ouro transfer to MoE models. At the 8BA0.8B (32BA3B when unrolled) scale trained on 500B tokens, Huginn outperforms Ouro on nearly all benchmarks spanning knowledge, reasoning, and coding, while also exhibiting more balanced expert routing. Under matched training and inference FLOPs, the Huginn-style model uses 75% fewer resident parameters than a 112-layer feedforward MoE baseline. Despite its smaller physical parameters, it outperforms the feedforward baseline on DROP and GSM8K, matches it on MATH500, and remains competitive on the other benchmarks.
original_abstract.source_title: Towards Looped Models Done Right, Part I: Topology, Input Injection, Recurrent-State Design

en.text: The study separates recurrence placement, input injection and recurrent-state organization in looped language models under matched budgets. A Huginn-style prelude–recurrent-block–coda design transfers from dense models to MoE models. At matched training and inference FLOPs, the tested looped MoE uses 75% fewer resident parameters than a 112-layer feedforward MoE, with benchmark-dependent quality. The findings inform parameter-sharing architecture choices, not measured recommender improvements.

zh.text: 循环模型的效果取决于循环放在哪里、怎样重新注入输入，以及如何组织隐状态。该研究在匹配预算下拆分这些设计，并将Huginn式前置层—循环模块—输出层结构从稠密模型迁移到MoE。在相同训练和推理FLOPs下，测试模型比112层前馈MoE少75%的常驻参数，任务表现各有差异；对推荐模型的收益仍待验证。

original_abstract.text: Fine-grained Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) is the de facto architecture for scaling large language models. However, dynamic expert load imbalance causes severe memory fluctuations that degrade training efficiency. Existing systems rely on static memory provisioning: they either over-provision, leaving GPU memory idle during normal execution, or under- provision, inviting out-of-memory crashes and costly manual rollbacks when load spikes occur. To address these challenges, we propose BaGuaLu-2, a large-scale MoE training system that eliminates this dilemma through flexible provisioning. By transforming memory allocation from a static, one-time tuning choice into a continuous and fine-grained control. BaGuaLu-2 grants exact activation memory on demand for each training batch. Furthermore, it offsets any dynamic management overhead through system optimizations. BaGuaLu-2 demonstrates exceptional scalability, training a model with 1040 billion parameters across 12,288 GPUs while sustaining over 2 EFlops at 35% MFU. Compared with state-of-the-art systems, BaGuaLu-2 delivers 1.14x and 1.13x average throughput improvements over Megatron-Kuai and AdaPipe, respectively.
original_abstract.source_title: BaGuaLu-2: Taming Dynamic Memory Fluctuation for Efficient MoE Model Training over 10,000 GPUs

en.text: BaGuaLu-2 addresses activation-memory fluctuations caused by MoE expert-load imbalance through per-batch dynamic provisioning and system optimizations. It trains a 1.04-trillion-parameter model on 12,288 GPUs at over 2 EFlops and 35% model FLOPs utilization. Reported average throughput is 1.14x Megatron-Kuai and 1.13x AdaPipe. The system offers a memory-management reference for large sparse-model training, with no recommendation-specific evaluation.

zh.text: BaGuaLu-2 针对 MoE 专家负载不均引起的激活显存波动，按训练批次动态分配内存，并用系统优化抵消管理开销。论文在 12,288 张 GPU 上训练 1.04 万亿参数模型，达到超过 2 EFlops 和 35% 的模型算力利用率；平均吞吐分别为 Megatron-Kuai、AdaPipe 的 1.14 倍和 1.13 倍。它为大型稀疏模型训练提供显存管理参考，未开展推荐专门评测。

original_abstract.text: Evaluating candidate changes (hypotheses) to recommendation models requires full-scale training runs consuming thousands of GPU-hours, severely limiting the hypothesis space engineers can feasibly explore. We introduce Predictable Scaling (PS), a systematic framework that exploits empirically verified regularity conditions to predict full-scale model performance from small-scale proxies. PS constructs scaled-down variants via composable scaling functions along distinct resource axes, and projects metrics to the target scale via curve fitting with calibrated uncertainty estimates. We compare three prediction strategies of increasing expressiveness: even the simplest (raw proxy) achieves prediction error within the empirical noise floor of repeated-run variance; the most expressive (Gaussian Process) provides an indicative 15% relative MAE improvement and calibrated uncertainty. Evaluation on two ranking models of increasing complexity---a task-specific model and a foundation model---demonstrates that PS correctly ranks actionable hypotheses across diverse hypothesis types at 79-88% compute reductions.
original_abstract.source_title: Predictable Scaling: Efficient Model Exploration via Scaling-Law Prediction

en.text: Predictable Scaling reduces the cost of testing recommendation-model changes by constructing smaller proxies along resource axes and extrapolating their metrics with calibrated uncertainty. On a task-specific ranking model and a foundation ranking model, it correctly ranks actionable hypotheses while reducing compute by 79–88%. These results depend on empirically checked regularity conditions; they do not establish universal transfer of proxy rankings.

zh.text: Predictable Scaling 为降低推荐模型方案试验的成本，沿资源维度构造小模型代理，再结合校准后的不确定性外推指标。在一个任务专用排序模型和一个基础排序模型上，它正确排列了具有实际价值的改进方案，计算量减少 79%–88%。结果依赖经过实证检查的规律性条件，并不意味着小模型排名能够普遍迁移。

original_abstract.text:
Current learned sparse approaches for recommender systems, such as STAR, represent a user by concatenating their interaction history into a single query string. For news, this creates two bottlenecks: concatenation collapses a user's distinct reading interests into one flat query, and, because news articles are long-form text, concatenating several news articles quickly overruns the context window of the language model used as backbone and forces quality-degrading truncation.
  To address both bottlenecks, we introduce learned sparse news recommendations (LSNR). LSNR encodes each article independently and constructs a sparse user vector by combining learned, attention-based weighting of the per-article sparse representations with a dense-projected expansion at the user level. Experiments on the MIND and EBNeRD datasets show that LSNR significantly outperforms STAR, with these gains holding even in short-history settings where truncation is not a factor. Compared to state-of-the-art dense recommenders, LSNR is competitive in standard settings and it outperforms them when the user history is short. An ablation of the user encoder confirms that learned attention-based aggregation outperforms simpler pooling alternatives. Beyond effectiveness, an additional advantage of LSNR is that it serves from an index an order of magnitude smaller than an uncompressed dense baseline.
original_abstract.source_title: LSNR: Learned Sparse News Recommendations with Attentive User Modeling

en.text: LSNR separately encodes news articles, then combines attention-weighted sparse article vectors with a dense-projected user expansion. This avoids flattening and truncating concatenated histories. On MIND and EBNeRD it outperforms STAR, remains competitive with dense recommenders in standard settings, and performs better with short histories. Its serving index is an order of magnitude smaller than the evaluated uncompressed dense baseline.

zh.text: 把新闻历史拼成一条长文本，既容易丢失不同兴趣，也容易超出上下文长度。LSNR先分别编码文章，再用注意力汇总稀疏表示并补充用户级扩展。在MIND和EBNeRD上优于STAR，常规设置下与稠密推荐模型相当，短历史下更好；其服务索引比所比较的未压缩稠密基线小一个数量级。

original_abstract.text: Language models can make personalized recommendations from rich item content, user history, and feedback. However, evaluating many candidates with full-text inputs incurs substantial online computation and limits serving throughput. We introduce DuoLM, a framework for fast and effective personalized recommendation that integrates a compact recommendation model with an efficient serving runtime. An encoder LLM learns compact item representations for offline reuse, while a personalized ranker LLM combines them with user history and feedback for recommendation. We train both models end to end with recommendation supervision and teacher distillation. The runtime further accelerates inference through virtual token IDs for embedding access, shared history computation, and CUDA Graph replay. Benchmark results show that our framework achieves recommendation quality comparable to that of the expert teacher model. On a single H100, it delivers approximately 26,400 candidate scores per second, about $60\times$ the throughput of the teacher served with vLLM and automatic prefix caching.
original_abstract.source_title: DuoLM: Fast and Effective Personalized Recommendation with Language Models

en.text: DuoLM separates an encoder that produces reusable compact item representations from a personalized LLM ranker, training both with recommendation supervision and teacher distillation. Virtual token IDs, shared history computation and CUDA Graph replay reduce serving overhead. Benchmarks retain quality comparable to the expert teacher; on one H100 the system scores about 26,400 candidates per second, roughly 60x the teacher throughput with vLLM and automatic prefix caching. The throughput comparison is specific to that hardware and serving setup.

zh.text: DuoLM 将可离线复用的紧凑商品编码与个性化 LLM 排序器分开，并通过推荐监督与教师蒸馏联合训练。运行时利用虚拟 token ID 访问嵌入、共享历史计算和 CUDA Graph 重放降低开销。基准上的质量接近专家教师模型；单张 H100 每秒可打分约 26,400 个候选，约为采用 vLLM 与自动前缀缓存的教师模型的 60 倍。该吞吐比较仅对应论文所测硬件与服务配置。

original_abstract.text: Recursive Transformers depend not only on how many parameters are shared, but also on how shared parameters are organized across depth. Existing static schemes adopt two extreme reuse topologies: layer-wise repetition, where each layer is reused independently, and global cyclic reuse, where the entire stack is repeatedly applied as a single shared function. We argue that sharing granularity is an important factor in recursive parameter sharing. This study proposes Block Recursive Transformers (BRT), which partition layers into contiguous blocks and recursively reuse each block before moving to the next. This intermediate topology enables local refinement within blocks while preserving depth-wise transitions, without adding routing modules, auxiliary states, or extra training objectives. Across decoder-only models up to 1.7B parameters, with additional encoder-decoder and encoder-only studies, BRT improves validation negative log-likelihood and downstream accuracy over static recursive sharing baselines. Ablations and representation analyses further show that intermediate block granularity better balances local refinement and depth-wise differentiation. Project website: https://aim-skku.github.io/BRT/
original_abstract.source_title: Block Recursive Transformers for Structured Parameter Sharing

en.text: Block Recursive Transformers partition layers into contiguous blocks and repeatedly apply each block before proceeding to the next. This intermediate sharing pattern balances local refinement and depth-wise differentiation without adding routing, auxiliary states or objectives. Across decoder-only models up to 1.7B parameters, with encoder-decoder and encoder-only studies, it improves validation loss and downstream accuracy over static recursive-sharing baselines. Recommendation transfer is untested.

zh.text: Block Recursive Transformers 将连续层划分成块，反复执行当前块后再进入下一块。这种中间粒度的共享方式平衡局部细化与不同深度的功能分化，无需新增路由、辅助状态或训练目标。在最高 17 亿参数的仅解码器模型及编码器—解码器、仅编码器实验中，它改善了静态递归共享基线的验证损失和下游准确率。推荐任务迁移尚未验证。
